useCase: Detección de alteración de imágenes via re-saving, quality inconsistencias, and spliced JPEG regions
mechanism: Re-compresses the image at multiple quality factors and mide the difference map for each. Regions that were previously compressed at a specific quality show minimal difference (ghost) at that quality level, revealing manipulación.
name: Análisis de Fantasma JPEG
parameters: Quality range: 50-99, Step: 1, Tamaño de bloque: 8x8, Detection umbral: adaptativo per-image
description: Detecta traces of previous compresión JPEGs (ghosts) that reveal re-saving or manipulación. generado por IA images may have inconsistent compression histories.

references.title: Farid, H. (2009). Exposing Digital Forgeries from JPEG Ghosts. IEEE TIFS.
Li, W. et al. (2009). Passive Detection of Doctored JPEG Image via Block Artifact Grid Extraction. Signal Processing.

strengths:
• Localiza regiones manipuladas específicamente
• Evidencia sólida de re-compresión
• Puede estimar el factor de calidad original
• Metodología forense bien comprobada
limitations:
• Solo funciona con imágenes JPEG
• Computacionalmente intensivo (multiple re-compressions)
• Same-quality re-compression is undetectable
• generado por IA JPEGs without alteración won't show ghosts
